name: Cosmic Combat
author: J_arvan
description:
Take control of a spaceship and fight off dangerous aliens! 

Controls:
Arrow Keys - Move
C - Shoot
Z / X - Use Powerup
ESC - Pause

My first personal project made in Unity. Sound effects come from the Unity Course Library and the music comes from 8-bit Fantasy & Adventure Music by xDeviruchi, and Blast Off! An 8-Bit Action Music Pack by Steve Base Music. :)
